payload.title: Build a bounded devnet reserve controller
payload.description:
Protect committed payouts and buffers; cap DRU exposure and holding duration; use executable quotes, hysteresis and atomic admission checks.

Acceptance criteria:
- Concurrent quotes cannot double-commit USDC; unavailable liquidity pauses new obligations.
- No DRU holdings or in-flight funds treated as spendable USDC; integer accounting throughout.
